libs.note: BH-7347 (slice C1 of #7300): the docker-pool host runner bin/docker-pool-runner.sh, which claims one queued row through the docker-pool lease and runs the builder image in local Docker. Resolved at call time with lib_env_apply docker-pool-host (dph_knob). The gate knobs are the C0 settings rows docker_pool.max_concurrent and docker_pool.kill. docs/notes/2026-10-18-BH-7347-docker-pool-runner.md.

knobs.note: The builder image ref the runner starts. Empty = the fly_images row of the project (fir_digest), else state/fly/<project>.image. A value outside [A-Za-z0-9._/:@-] is empty. Not settable: an image is code the host runs with the env bundle mounted.
docker run --platform. The builder image is amd64 only, so a Mac runs it under Rosetta. A value outside [A-Za-z0-9/_-] is linux/amd64.
docker run --cpus of one build (Fly performance-8x parity).
docker run --memory of one build, a number with an optional b/k/m/g suffix; anything else is 16g.
The host directory of the work dirs <root>/<project>/<key>-<tag>. Empty = $HARNESS/state/docker-pool. Not settable: dph_retention deletes under it.

The harness checkout the runner tars into the container's /data/harness (bin prompts rules catalog fleet.conf fly). Empty = the repo root of bin/docker-pool-runner.sh. Not settable: a path whose code the container runs.
One docker-pool heartbeat per this many seconds, cut to a third of the lease left at the claim. A settings row is clamped to 10..600; an env value is used as it stands.
When heartbeats fail, the runner stops the container at the last lease_until minus this, so the hub sweep never requeues a row a live container still builds.
docker stop -t: the time builder-runner's TERM trap has to flush its cost rows.
Wall cap of one build; past it the container is stopped and the row released (queued with no RESULT). 21600 = the hub's 360-minute claim window.
How long the smoke verb waits for the container's RESULT.
Work dirs older than this are deleted at each runner start (dph_retention). They hold no money row: C2's result row is the record.
